role: Leader of the original Getter Team; pilot of the flight forms (Getter-1, Getter Dragon, Shin Getter-1)
personality: Hot-blooded, eager for a fight even against powerful foes; compassionate but vengeful toward those who wrong others; karate master trained by his late father
note: Daikessen version is based on the manga version. Some fan sources write 'Ryouma'; the wiki uses 'Ryoma'.

role: Getter Team member; pilot of the ground forms (Getter-2, Getter Liger, Shin Getter-2)
personality: Former revolutionary and troublemaker who disliked authority; cynical realist, the most intelligent of the team, but will not throw away comrades' lives
note: Japanese name order is Jin Hayato; English uses given-name-first 'Hayato Jin'. In Daikessen he has no ties to NISAR.

role: Third pilot of the original Getter Robo (Getter-3); former school judo captain
personality: Lively and happy-go-lucky, stubborn, full of bravado; tough when the Getter or his friends are involved; willing to risk his life for friends
note: Unlike other versions he survives in Daikessen and can pilot Shin Getter Robo. Creator of the judo throw Daisetsuzan Oroshi.

role: Pilot of the aquatic/heavy Getter formation (Getter Poseidon); fourth member of the Getter Team (reinforcement, not a replacement for Musashi)
personality: Big-hearted, generally happy-go-lucky; will risk his life when friends are in danger; baseball-trained body

jp: 早乙女博士 / 早乙女
role: Director of the Saotome Getter Ray Research Institute; creator of Getter Robo; father of Tatsuhito and Michiru (and Genki)
personality: Intimidating, likened to a mad scientist, obsessive about Getter Rays, willing to go to extremes, but not heartless and hopeful

jp: 早乙女ミチル / ミチル
role: Dr. Saotome's daughter; pilots Lady Command and can pilot other machines including Getter robots
personality: Friendly and polite, can be rough with family (especially her father); supportive; treats the Getter Team as close friends (no romance in Daikessen)

role: Dr. Saotome's eldest son; pilot trainer for candidate pilots; creator of Black Getter; his father's right-hand man
personality: Disciplined, focused, close to his family; wears glasses in this version
note: Survives to the end in Daikessen, unlike other versions.

role: Leader of the Tachibana Institute's Getter Team; pilot of Getter Go (flight mode of Getter Robo Go)
personality: Hot-blooded, brash and sarcastic, takes risks, works well with his team
note: 號 is the old form of 号 (gō). Wiki writes 'Go' (sometimes 'Gō'). Do not confuse with the suffix 号 in machine names (Eagle-Gou etc.).

role: Pilot of Getter Sho; daughter of Dr. Tachibana, younger sister of Shinichi
personality: Serious-minded, brave and diligent; shares a near-psychic bond with her brother Shinichi; earns Schwartz's respect and affection

role: Pilot of Getter Gai (water/bombardment mode of Getter Robo Go); originally a mechanic
personality: Deep affection and respect for the Getter; understands machines by sound and vibration; tough when needed
note: Wiki also writes 'Daidō'. The form name is 'Getter Gai' (ゲッター剴; also written ゲッター凱 in some places).

role: Head of the Tachibana Institute; creator of Getter Robo Go, helped develop Getter Robo Zan; colleague and partner of Dr. Saotome; father of Sho and Shinichi
personality: Determined that his son's sacrifice not be in vain; puts his faith in the Getter; at heart a pacifist

jp: プロフェッサー・ランドウ / ランドウ
role: Leader of the Vega Zone forces and creator of the Metal Beasts; mad scientist turned cyborg; main antagonist
personality: Megalomaniacal, sociopathic, proud of his 'invincible' Metal Beasts, easily frustrated by setbacks
note: Naive romanization would be 'Professor Randou'; the wiki uses 'Lando'. Full name on the wiki: Alrich zu Lando.

role: Ruler of the Hyakki Empire; pilots Uzahra; later revived as a cyborg
personality: Megalomaniacal, power-mad, sees all other lifeforms as beneath him
note: Literal 'Great Emperor Burai'; some manga-based pages say 'Burai the Great'. The Daikessen page uses 'Emperor Burai'.

role: Ruler of the Dinosaur Empire
personality: Highly prideful, believes Dinosaur People superior to humans, terrified of the Getter Robo because of Getter Rays
note: Naive romanization 'Goru/Gooru'; the established spelling is 'Gore'.

role: Ruler of the Dinosaur Empire (alternate title used in the script)
note: Literal meaning 'Demon King Gore'. No source gives an English form of this title; the wiki only uses 'Emperor Gore'. Use 'Demon King Gore' only if the script deliberately contrasts the two titles.

role: Emperor Gore's second-in-command, high-ranking warrior of the Dinosaur Empire
personality: Devoted to the Empire and Gore; cooler-headed than his lord, knows when he is beaten

role: General Bat revived as a cyborg under Vega Zone; pilots Mecha Typhoon
note: Literal 'Remodeled General Bat'; the wiki calls him 'Cyborg Bat'. 'Cyborg General Bat' is an acceptable longer form.

role: Emperor Gore revived as a cyborg under Vega Zone
note: Literal 'Remodeled Gore'; wiki: 'Cyborg Gore'.

role: Emperor Burai revived as a cyborg under Vega Zone
note: Literal 'Remodeled Burai'; wiki: 'Cyborg Burai' (gallery caption: 'Emperor Burai as a Cyborg/Zombie').

role: Executive of Vega Zone and Professor Lando's personal aide; commands the Dragon Turtle
personality: Very loyal to Lando (unlike his manga counterpart, not a Dinosaur Empire member)
note: Wiki title: 'Count Rasetsu'. Use 'Count Rasetsu' when a title is needed. Human/cyborg.

role: Petty officer of the Andromeda Country (insect army from the future)
note: Wiki lists 'Petty Officer Gimbug' on the game and Andromeda Country pages, but the page itself does not exist, so there is no description or gender. Naive romanization would be 'Giimubagu'.

role: Leader of the Chiryu Clan group of the Dinosaur Empire sent to attack the Saotome Institute; controls a mass-produced Getter Robo
personality: Loyal to the Chiryu Clan, will take any job that might win them equal rights in the Empire; has foresight (can see the future)
note: Naive romanization 'Nion'; the wiki spells it 'Neon'.

role: Insectoid forces of the Andromeda Country
note: No English form found. Wiki describes the Andromeda Country's members as humanoid insects with giant biomechanical insects. 'Insect Legion' also works.

jp: ジャック・キング / ジャック
role: American pilot of Texas Mack's main body; Mary's older brother; Allied Robot Corps
personality: Cocky cowboy, brags about small victories; comes to respect the Getter Team; good pilot; speaks Japanese with a heavy American accent and drops English phrases
note: His speech style (broken Japanese mixed with English) is a character trait; render it as cowboy-flavored English.

jp: メリー・キング / メリー
role: Co-pilot of Texas Mack (pilots from the hat / data gathering); Jack's younger sister; Allied Robot Corps
personality: Confident in Texas Mack, less cocky than Jack; gains respect for the Getter Team; heavy American accent, drops English phrases
note: Naive romanization 'Meri'; established spelling 'Mary'.

jp: ジョン・ランバート / ランバート
role: Co-pilot and gunner of the Stilva α04, partner of Schwartz; US military, Allied Robot Corps
personality: Middle-aged, scarred veteran; more accepting of outside help (including the Getter Team) than Schwartz; soft-spoken
note: Manga page titles him 'General John Lambert'. He dies in the manga's Alaska arc; alive status listed for Daikessen.

role: Pilot/co-pilot of the Stilva α04, partnered with John Lambert; US Army soldier of German descent, Allied Robot Corps
personality: Hot-tempered, initially hates the Japanese (past tragedies) and looks down on others and women; grows into a rivalry with Go and develops feelings for Sho
note: Full name on the wiki: 'Schwartz Koff' (Japanese シュワルツコフ, a play on Schwarzkopf). Naive romanization 'Schwarz'; the wiki spells it 'Schwartz'.

jp: ヒム・シャトナー / シャトナー
role: Pilot of Gustaf H-24; German military, Allied Robot Corps
personality: Confident, a bit cocky against weaker foes, but no coward; patriotic; swore vengeance on Lando after his hometown was destroyed
note: Naive romanization 'Him Shatner'; the wiki spells it 'Heim'.

role: Lead pilot of Getter Robo Zan, pilots the flight mode Getter Rekka; member of the Tachibana Institute's ninjutsu-trained black-ops/spy team
personality: Hot-blooded, eager for a good fight (like Ryoma) but more level-headed; the one who keeps her teammates in line
note: Full name: Akane Mizuki (水樹茜). New character created for Daikessen. Fights with a sword (Hizanto).

role: Second pilot of Getter Robo Zan, pilots the ground mode (Getter Shiten); Tachibana Institute, ninjutsu-trained
personality: Analytical and the most intelligent of the Zan team, makes hard decisions; like Hayato but more compassionate and less cynical; will die alongside teammates if they choose sacrifice
note: Full name: Tsubaki Akiyama (秋山椿). New character created for Daikessen. Tall.

role: Third pilot of Getter Robo Zan, pilots the sea/heavy mode Getter Kongo; Tachibana Institute black-ops team, ninjutsu-trained
personality: Lively, happy-go-lucky, stubborn about missions, tough when friends are threatened, indomitable will; scared of bugs; physically powerful judo/ninjutsu fighter
note: Full name: Kaede Shibasaki (柴崎楓). New character created for Daikessen. Voiced by Miki Tsuchiya.

role: Sho's older brother and Dr. Tachibana's son; brainwashed into a Vega Zone cyborg soldier, pilots the Metal Beast Garon Z-54
personality: Originally supportive and close to his family (shares a psychic bond with Sho); emotionless mind-slave after conversion; reverts to himself when near death
note: Full name: Shinichi Tachibana. Dies in Daikessen.

role: Hayato's cousin; took over Hayato's old revolutionary gang and allied with the Hyakki Empire; cybernetically enhanced, acts as the head of Maoki
personality: Cares for his cousin but lusts for power to rule Japan; knows his limits and wants Hayato on his side
note: Naive romanization 'Ryuuji'; wiki uses 'Ryuji'. Dies in Daikessen.

role: Possibly the NISAR staff member Furuta from the Getter Robo Go manga

role: Pilot of the British Army's super robot (Kingdom 007) in the Allied Robot Corps
personality: Skilled and very confident; quiet in battle, decent but sometimes awkward socially
note: Full name: Linda Tiramis. Her Daikessen wiki page says she pilots 'London 007' (a page that does not exist); the game page lists Kingdom 007 as the British unit, so this is probably a wiki slip.

role: Co-pilot of Robo Sun T-520 with his brother Sam; Canadian Army, Allied Robot Corps
